populationDefinition: All unique post records currently recoverable from the WOW List public Facebook Page timeline in an authenticated Page-management view.

currentProfileDisplay.meaning: Mutable profile display at capture, not historic reach.

currentEngagementDisplay.meaning: Mutable platform displays at capture, not attendance, historic reach, or project impact.

postedUrlInventory.meaning: Research routes; a posted URL is not proof of destination claims, endorsement, clicks, or outcomes.

limitations: This is 100% of the currently recoverable public timeline population, not an official Meta export of all posts ever created.
Deleted, unpublished, pre-migration-omitted, and otherwise unavailable posts remain outside the observable population.
Facebook obfuscates many timeline timestamps and no longer exposes every historic outbound href.
Publisher metadata supports publishing activity, not sole administration, sole project ownership, or authorship of shared sources.
